mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and consumer spending (RSAFS) declines for two consecutive months, it indicates a dual stress on the labor market and consumption, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE >= 5.0% and RSAFS falls for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE >= 5.0% and RSAFS falls for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1,150,000 units indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector, which is a leading indicator of weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which dampens corporate profit growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with positive real GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls below 50,000 persons (PAYEMS change < 50.0) signals a sluggish labor market, which dampens consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS monthly change < 50.0.
